title: AI in the Wild: A Meta-Analytic Evaluation of Depression Detection from Social Media Data

live_model.evidence: "A human reviewer and GPT-4 Turbo—using the prompt reproduced in Appendix A—independently [coded study characteristics]".

prompt.note: Supports only a coding/annotation role, not a benchmark capability claim.

claim.metric: none tied to GPT-4 Turbo's own capability; the paper's predictive-accuracy findings (Accuracy, F1, r trends over time) summarize depression-detection models reported in the reviewed studies, not GPT-4 Turbo itself

data.source: Meta-analysis corpus of published depression-detection studies (systematic review)

notes: This is a meta-analysis; GPT-4 Turbo is used only to help code/extract study-level variables (role A) alongside a human reviewer, not to detect depression itself.
